experiment_data.hypothesis: CRM correction magnitude as zero-overhead gating signal. Three correlation pairs: (1) ρ(K1_correction_mag, K10_var) — primary GO/NO-GO (threshold ρ>0.3); (2) ρ(K2_argmin_correction_mag, K10_var) — fallback if K1 fails; (3) ρ(K1_correction_mag, K2_L2_distance) — cross-validate with proven K=2 signal. If GO: zero-cost adaptive K (CRM 0.25ms, no extra VLA inference).
